vellum_obligation: On Graphite, the persistent-scene blit and a retained layer's seal must not copy the surface (SkSurfaces::AsImage or Surface::draw), with a documented ordering guarantee that frame N's blit is recorded before frame N+1's draws; non-textureable surfaces fall back to a copy. A readback of the persistent scene must not take a legacy snapshot of it (copy with AsImageCopy), so the scene never mixes snapshot and AsImage.
evidence: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Graphite AsImage view of a surface sees later draws into it'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaCanvas Graphite layer seal shares the layer texture'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface persistent-scene blit presents each frame.s own scene'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface persistent-scene frames do not copy the scene'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface readback fallback keeps the scene blit free of snapshot warnings'
